heroHeadline: Day 728: New Suspects Identified in Ayotzinapa Case as 12th Anniversary of Students' Disappearance Approaches
heroSubtitle: On September 28, 2026 (Day 727), Sheinbaum said the Ayotzinapa investigation into the 43 missing students remains open and announced a new report on fresh lines of inquiry ahead of the 12th anniversary. She warned of Category 3 Hurricane Polo approaching Comondú, Baja California Sur, and said employment reached 60.7 million people. The day before, she closed her 32-state accountability tour at the Zócalo.
